description: Source code for pathspec handling in a Git-like version control system, including functions for matching pathspecs against index entries, parsing pathspecs, and handling pathspec attributes.

methods.name: add_pathspec_matches_against_index
methods.description: Finds which pathspecs match items in the index and updates the seen array accordingly.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_against_index
methods.description: Allocates and returns a seen array indicating the closest matches of pathspecs against the index.

methods.name: find_pathspecs_matching_skip_worktree
methods.description: Finds pathspec matches in the index, skipping worktrees, and returns a seen array.

methods.name: pathspec_magic_names
methods.description: Outputs the names of magic pathspec bits for debugging or display.

methods.name: unsupported_magic
methods.description: Handles unsupported magic in pathspecs by terminating execution with an error.

methods.name: parse_pathspec
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a pathspec structure, handling magic and attributes.

methods.name: parse_pathspec_file
methods.description: Reads a file of pathspecs and parses them into a pathspec structure.

methods.name: copy_pathspec
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a pathspec.

methods.name: clear_pathspec
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a pathspec.

methods.name: match_pathspec_attrs
methods.description: Checks if index attributes match the specified pathspec attributes.

methods.name: pathspec_needs_expanded_index
methods.description: Determines if the index needs to be expanded based on the pathspec.
